title: Letters Concerning Viola Petchura

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D....147....
Date......9. 4. 29....

April 9,

Dear Sir,

In reply to your letter of March 11, 1929,
I have to inform you that your daughter, Viola Letchura,
is residing at the Institution of the Holy Family,
No. 26 Bunsan Road, and is in good health.
She is willing to proceed to England, but
has no money to defray the expense of the journey,
and there is no hope of the Mother Superior being
able to arrange for her to work her passage as a maid
or companion or in some other capacity.
The British Consulate knows about the
case of your daughter, and I would suggest that all
further communications on the subject of her going
to England be addressed to them.

Yours faithfully,

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

F. C. Lansdale Esq.,
28 Yuscham Road,
East Dereham,
Norfolk, England.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
编号 I. O. D....147....
日期......1929年4月9日....

4月9日，

尊敬的先生：

就您1929年3月11日的来信，兹告知您，您的女儿维奥拉·莱丘拉（Viola Letchura）现居住于本山路26号圣家会院（Institution of the Holy Family），身体健康。她愿意前往英国，但无力支付旅费，且院长修女表示无法安排她以女仆、伴侣或其他身份做工抵偿船票。英国领事馆已知悉您女儿的案情，建议您今后关于其赴英事宜的所有进一步通信均直接致函该馆。

此致

敬礼

代理刑事调查处处长

F. C. 兰斯代尔（F. C. Lansdale）先生，
英格兰诺福克郡东迪勒姆（East Dereham）
尤沙姆路（Yuscham Road）28号。

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No.
April 8th 1929.

Sir
Viola Petchurn is now residing at the Institution of
the Holy Family, No 26 Unsan Road Enquiries there
show that the girl is willing to proceed to England but
has no money with which to pay her passage. As she is
rather backward and none too reliable the Mother Superior
does not feel she could recommend her as a nurse or
companion to any lady proceeding home who would be willing
to pay her passage in return for services during the
voyage.

Mr Jamieson H. B. M. Consul states that a letter
has been received from the Foreign Office and that no
objection to granting her a passport would be offered, but
her passage could not possibly be paid by the British
Consular Authorities.

W Ounean
D.S.

A.R. H
8/39.
/D. . I.

C.I.D. Reg.
Please draft a reply to
Mr Lansdale, telling him that his
daughter is well, the difficulties about the
passage, and recommending that
further enquiries be addressed to the British
Consulate.
NKS 8/4/29

（刑事调查处）办公笔记
档案编号
1929年4月8日。

先生
维奥拉·佩彻恩（Viola Petchurn）现居住于安山路（Unsan Road）26号圣家会院。经向该院查询，该女孩愿意前往英国，但无钱支付船票。由于她智力较为迟钝且不太可靠，院长修女认为无法将她推荐给任何愿意以途中服务换取免付船票的回国女士担任护士或伴侣。

詹姆森（Jamieson）先生，大英帝国领事，称已收到英国外交部来函，表示对其签发护照无异议，但英国领事当局绝不可能为其支付船票。

W 奥尼恩（Ounean）
副巡长

A.R. H
8/39.
/D. . I.

刑事调查处登记室
请起草给兰斯代尔先生的回信，告知他其女儿安好，说明船票方面的困难，并建议进一步查询事宜径洽英国领事馆。
NKS 1929年4月8日

11th March 1929.
Mr. J.C. Lonsdale
28 Yareham Rd.
East Dereham
Norfolk. England

Dear Sir
Could you please help me to
find out about my Step Daughter "Viola
Petchwa", at present at school in
"St Joseph's Institution," 28 Rue Montauban.
Last July I had a letter from the "Home
Office" at London and a copy of the
permit that was sent from the "Home
Office" to the "British Consul" at Shanghai
for the Consul to give my Stepdaughter
help and arrangements for her to travel
to this country to us her Mother &
Stepfather and now she writes and tell
us that the British Consul knows nothing
about it, and as my Stepdaughter is
only 16 and must leave that school
shortly I should very much like to
know the truth. I get her to England
with us, I am only a poor man
and cannot afford the money to

J.C. 朗斯代尔（Lonsdale）先生
雅雷哈姆路（Yareham Rd.）28号
东迪勒姆（East Dereham）
诺福克郡，英格兰

尊敬的先生
能否请您帮我查一下我的继女“维奥拉·佩奇瓦”（Viola Petchwa）的情况，她目前在蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）28号“圣约瑟夫书院”（St Joseph's Institution）就读。去年七月，我收到伦敦“内政部”的来信，以及一份从“内政部”发给上海“英国领事”的许可证副本，以便领事协助我的继女并安排她前往本国与我们——她的母亲和继父——团聚。但现在她写信告诉我们，英国领事对此事一无所知，鉴于我的继女年仅16岁，且不久必须离开该校，我非常希望能了解真相。[我想]接她来英国与我们在一起，我只是个穷人，负担不起这笔钱去
